item: Row J: outlet_expr counts the domain or the integer source id, with no string built per row
summary: outlet_expr was coalesce(domain, 'source-' || cast(id as text)); it is now coalesce(domain, source_id): the same outlets (SQLite DISTINCT keeps an integer and a text value apart, so an orphan id and a domain written in digits stay two outlets), pinned against the old spelling on a store with each awkward case and, red without, by the absence of a cast and a concatenation in the compiled SQL. Measured on 2.34 M mentions in the window with the app's own engine and session (plaintext, median of 7): the story-propagation candidate query 6.47 s with the string, 5.37 s without, 4.28 s counting source ids. A persisted outlet key was measured and left unbuilt: a per-mention column buys nothing over one on sources, and any later build has three conditions (a trigger, an AFTER DELETE rule, J1's rebuild recreating the triggers), recorded in the lesson fragment, which amends Row J left open (1). Not measured: an encrypted store, 20.9 M mentions, the other three gates' queries, concurrent writers.
